title: jurinea orientalis
intro: Jurinea orientalis, commonly known as the Oriental Jurinea or Mongolian Swan Plant, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is native to various regions in Asia, including China and Mongolia. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Jurinea orientalis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
